workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Server background tasks fail with `sentry-sdk` 3.0.0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix background tasks failing with sentry-sdk 3. Target files: pyproject.toml. New environments install `sentry-sdk` 3.0.0, released on 2026-11-23, and the server then fails: every pipeline and scheduled task raises `AttributeError: module 'sentry_sdk' has no attribute 'start_transaction'`, so runs, instances, fleets, gateways and volumes are not processed. With `DSTACK_SENTRY_DSN` set, `sentry_sdk.init` raises `TypeError: Unknown option 'enable_tracing'`. pyright fails in CI for the same calls. (Ref: https://github.com/dstackai/dstack/pull/4514)
